title: Prez #3 DC Comics October 2015 Mark Russell Ben Caldwell Cover A Beth Ross
condition_description: Bright and clean with light handling wear. See photos.
description:
Prez #3 (October 2015), DC Comics - Beth Ross, the first teen president of the United States, is sworn in. Mark Russell story, Ben Caldwell art and cover, Mark Morales and Jeremy Lawson. Direct sales, $2.99 cover price.

Back cover: Snickers "Tempting" ad.

Condition: bright and clean with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
